svg.title: Switch, single-pole single-throw
svg.desc: Switch, single-pole single-throw, IEEE 315-1975 §4.6.1 switch, single-throw, with §5.1.1 terminals (Introduction A4.7). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (13,8), end (13,88).
